title: Reject unsafe amendments without over-applying replanning

rubric.text: Keeps the decision proportional, references settled requirements and work rather than reproducing a full recipe, but preserves concrete identities, affected interfaces, meaningful tests and failure evidence.

Distinguishes supported unchanged-scope integration from non-overlap/no-op, unknown preservation and material architecture/privacy/permission/qualification changes; unchanged issue text alone proves nothing.

Requires authenticated append-only complete lineage, trusted prior anchors, fresh source/base/candidate/PR identities, native readiness and independent review/approval; ambiguous writes are reconciled before retry and artifacts are preserved.

Delivery retains owner/work/PR and renews affected evidence with exact result provenance; controller verifies effective contract and existing leases without an unnecessary Todo/Ready reset. No expanded external grants or qualification waivers.

Separates pending integration result from exact starting candidate and readiness; preserves traceable valid full-candidate review and does not claim model execution, live provider proof or consumer adoption from offline snapshots.

Explains all six scenario assessments with evidence needed to release blockers; the route JSON is only a deterministic classification check, while preservation, authority and reasoning are assessed by this rubric.
